headline: Why Isn't My Structured Data Showing Up in Google?
articleBody: It's super frustrating when you put in the work to add structured data and then... crickets. You're probably wondering why your awesome content isn't fueling rich results or getting picked up by AI. Often, it comes down to a few common snags. Your schema might not be totally accurate for the content on your page, or maybe it doesn't meet Google's guidelines for rich results. Sometimes, folks use FAQ schema for things that aren't actually FAQs, like advertising, or the answers aren't clear and concise. Another big one is skipping validation. You've got to test your markup! If you're not seeing the rich results you expect, a good first step is to check Google Search Console. It'll show you if there are any errors in your structured data that are preventing it from being used. You'd be surprised how often a small, missed step in the validation process can lead to big headaches. If you've got a lot of templated pages, or you're running into persistent errors, that's when a professional can really help debug things and ensure your structured data is humming along, making your site more visible to AI. Don't just sit there, let's get your structured data working for you!
